cards.title: Blue Shell warning sign, two-colour laminate
warnings: Pocket outline (18 contours, 110×110mm): pitch 0.25 mm, clamped to the cutter's 0.25 mm tip radius from the requested 0.348 mm — a wider pitch would leave a ridge of the top colour down strokes narrower than two passes apart.

two or more strokes of Pocket outline (18 contours, 110×110mm) are closer than 0.107 mm (2 × the 0.054 mm surface wall offset): their V openings merge at the top face and leave a ridge of the top colour below the colour plane.

program 2 (⌀ 3.175 mm flat end): Cut-out "Cut out outside Pocket outline (1 contour, 110×110mm)" asks for 4 holding tabs 3 mm wide: 2 are placed (at X 64.203 Y 121.046, X 9.882 Y 61.608) and 2 could not be, because the cut path has no other straight or smoothly curved edge with enough free length. The part is held by the tabs that fit; add the rest by hand, use a smaller tab width or count, or cut a larger outline.

cards.title: Panther, laid flat on the hardwood stick (3D goal)
cards.source: the maintainer’s nude_pantherv2-final.stl (local input), scaled in the app to the 36 × 36 × 100 stick
warnings: Only -11.9 mm of the stock is gripped below the jaw tops; under 3 mm the part can lift (a provisional threshold).

The top setup reproduces 39 % of the goal's surface. 47 % of its surface faces away from the tool — downward faces and undercuts — and 14 % lies in an overhang's shadow, so it is not cut from this side. A flip finishes it: top, then bottom, then right edge, then left edge, then front edge — 5 setups reach 95 % of the surface. That is the geometry the sides expose: how much of it the CHOSEN CUTTER reproduces is the run's own simulation verdict. Setup 1 drills two ⌀3.175 mm locating holes 38 mm deep in the margin, clear of the part, and setup 2 registers on them.
